description: Get the full text of one Journal article with its title, URL and reviewer. Identify it by the slug, id or URL that search_journal returned, or by title (best match). Use after search_journal when the summary is not enough.

id.description: The article id, as returned by search_journal.

slug.description: The article’s URL slug, as returned by search_journal.

title.description: The title or part of it; the best match is returned.

url.description: The full article URL on ilitsociety.org.

name: get_article
title: Read a Journal article
